title: Microporous carbon enhanced by structural modifications to suppress polysulfide shuttling and reduce capacity fading in lithium–sulfur batteries
content:
Energy Adv., 2026, 5,810-823
DOI: 10.1039/D6YA00026F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Delvina Japhet Tarimo, Francisco J. García-Soriano, Alen Vizintin, Christian Prehal, Elena Tchernychova, Volker Presser
Using nickel sulfate, AC900S was modified to AC900S-Ni without metallic Ni deposition. Instead, carbon graphitization increased (higher sp2 fraction), improving conductivity, polysulfide anchoring, charge-transfer kinetics, and cycling stability.
